correctness.rationale: The degree-2 Boolean Walsh and constant/one-/two-position indicator spans coincide by (−1)^X=1−2X, with labeled positions and symbols. I independently enumerated all 231-avoiders through n=6 and row-reduced exact F2 event bitsets: Catalan counts 1,2,5,14,42,132, and ranks 1,2,5,14,42,112 with 382 distinct feasible observation columns at six. An independent direct audit of all 20 packaged signed integer kernel6.json relations checked every event sum exactly zero; their coefficient vectors are independent mod 2, giving real nullity at least 20, while rank mod2=112 is a real rank lower bound, hence exactly 112. Exhaustive disjoint 3-pair switch-orbits on the 132 states gave precisely 12 distinct valid 8-state cubes; each is an annihilating trade and the 12-span is proper to the 20-d kernel. The explicit three adjacent-pair alternating cube persists under fixed increasing tails at all n>=6, proving infinite noninjectivity without extrapolation.

originality.rationale: PASS bounded: prior low-order permutation Fourier and marginal work treats the full permutation group or rank-factorized models; Catalan avoidance enumeration and comparison-query shattering concern different observables. Here the exact labeled-position degree-2 rank threshold on Av(231), a 20-d signed kernel and the proper 12-d elementary-cube subspace are not inferred from those prior implications. Resultary query did not surface an exact same class/marginal nullity table; historical alternative fixed-position tomography formulations remain a residual risk.

This is not an arbitrary tiny computation or unsupported significance claim.
